title: Check declared subjects before recording a decision
actor: An engineering agent acting on an explicit project decision
goal: Keep the supplied decision basis distinct from current mechanical observations.
context: The agent has identified relevant subjects and must communicate its actual observed basis in a later recording request.
trigger: The agent prepares a review or submits a task with declared compared reads.
preconditions: The actor has selected contained subjects and supplied its reported or compared basis.

interaction.action: Supplies the explicit selected subjects and expectations rather than asking the system to infer relevant files.
Checks admitted compared reads and reports current observations separately from attributed judgment.
Reconciles any changed basis before submitting a fresh decision.

expected_outcome: A mismatch cannot silently refresh expectations or broaden approval; reported basis remains honestly labeled.

alternatives.outcome: Keep its attribution without presenting it as mechanical repository comparison.

alternatives.condition: An explicitly selected path must be absent.
alternatives.outcome: Check that absence as a declared precondition without inventing a present subject.

failures.condition: A declared compared subject differs or changes during inspection.
failures.outcome: Return a gap or dependent-write conflict without silently substituting the new basis.

failures.condition: A declared path is unsafe, symlinked, unreadable or exceeds limits.
failures.outcome: Reject or report the applicable gap without broadening selection or executing content.
